summary: Frontend review of PR #77 (NFR-REL-001 Auto-Save Crash Durability) completed with CHANGES REQUESTED verdict. 1 high-severity blocking issue found: useAutoSave.ts passes empty bricks array and hardcoded data to every auto-save instead of reading from sceneStore, defeating the entire auto-save feature. 2 medium issues: (M1) test files use inline implementations instead of importing real source code, (M2) silent error swallowing in persistenceService.ts. 5 low suggestions including package.json scope creep with breaking major version bumps. Architecture, idb usage, atomic transactions, crash detection, accessibility, and data-testid attributes all pass review.

blocking.title: Hardcoded empty data in auto-save interval
blocking.description: Hook passes empty bricks array [], hardcoded camera state, and placeholder metadata to triggerAutoSave(). Never reads from sceneStore. Every auto-save persists an empty scene.
blocking.impact: E2E tests T-BE-REL-001-01 and T-BE-REL-001-02 will fail. Defeats the entire auto-save feature.
blocking.fix: Read actual scene state from sceneStore using useSceneStore selectors.

medium.title: Tests use inline implementations instead of actual source
medium.description: Both test files define their own inline implementations rather than importing the actual source. Tests validate the contract but not the shipped code.
medium.fix: Update imports to use real implementations.

medium.title: Silent error swallowing in meta read
medium.description: Empty catch block when reading existing meta silently resets saveCount to 1 on any error.

low.title: Multiple empty catch blocks need console.warn
Scope creep: breaking major version bumps, removed deps and scripts

passing_checks: All 10 test IDs from LLD Section 12 covered

human_review_required.item: Gate 8 — Confirm H1 fix (useAutoSave reads from sceneStore)
Confirm package.json scope changes are intentional (L5)
Verify test imports updated to real implementations (M1)

recommended_actions: Fix H1: Update useAutoSave.ts to read bricks, cameraState, sceneMetadata from sceneStore
Fix M1: Update ResumePrompt.test.tsx and useAutoSave.test.ts to import real implementations
Fix M2: Add console.warn to catch block in persistenceService.ts line 74
Address L5: Revert package.json changes that are out of scope, or confirm they are intentional
